title: Workspace declaration v2 (oats-workspace.yaml)
description: Data shape only. Members carry NO revision (a member is always its latest state); `external` sources REQUIRE a full 40-hex commit; absolute filesystem paths are refused anywhere in this file (host paths belong in oats-local.yaml). Reciprocal membership is observed over Git remotes, not declared here.

members.description: Repo refs without revision. Each becomes a member only when its oats-membership.yaml names this workspace back.

packages.description: The ONLY versioned things: <package-id>: <version | git ref with @revision>.

teams.description: SHARED teams: <label>: { description?, team? }. `team` is the messaging provider's team id, the same for everyone; without it the team is declared but not yet created (readiness team-unmapped). The default team and which teams each soul may join are defaultTeam and souls: below; a deployment's local teams live in its oats-local.yaml where localTeams allows them. A label never gates, restricts or partitions anything.

defaultTeam.description: The workspace's fallback default team, a label of teams: in this file: a soul's souls: default wins over it, and so does a deployment's local defaultTeam where localTeams: true.

localTeams.description: Whether deployments may declare their own teams and defaultTeam in oats-local.yaml (every soul may join a local team). Absent: false; then local teams and a local defaultTeam are refused (E_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA reason local-teams-closed).

souls.description: Per soul pattern ("*", <member|package>/* or <member|package>/<soul>), the soul's default team and the other teams it may join. The most specific key gives the soul's teams outright (lists never merge); the most specific key that sets a default gives its default. A soul no key matches has its default only. Every label is a label of teams: in this file.

sandboxes.description: Boundaries (docs/workspaces.md, Sandboxes): <name>: { team, egress?, credentials?, description? }. A soul whose resolved default team is a sandbox's team runs inside that sandbox on a host whose oats-local.yaml lists it. One sandbox per team; a sandboxed team is only ever a soul's default, named for that soul (never through defaultTeam, a pattern, another soul's teams, "any" or an alias). Kernels before feature sandboxes refuse this key: add it only once every host of the workspace lists that feature.

messaging.description: Opaque provider payload consumed by the messaging core capability. A team's provider id is teams.<label>.team.

tasks.description: Opaque provider payload consumed by the capability that fills the tasks slot, merged at the same layer as messaging: (above the manifest's defaults, below a soul's tasks: payload). Kernels before the workspace-tasks-payload feature refuse this key.

external.description: Souls adopted by reference from repos that are NOT members; pinned to a full commit.

label.description: A team label: at most 64 characters (0.44.0), the length the Desktop shows.

sandboxName.description: A sandbox's name: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens. Its server is sandbox-<name>.

credentialName.description: A credential's name: each host's oats-local.yaml credentials: says where its file is.

team.description: A label of teams: in this file; no other sandbox names its team, by label or provider id. A team without a provider id keeps the file valid; the sandbox's start and a routed spawn refuse (E_SANDBOX_TEAM team-not-created).

egress.description: The external egress roles added to the base routes, each once: model (https://api.anthropic.com), source (https://github.com), forge (https://api.github.com; feature sandbox-egress-forge). Absent: [].

credentials.description: The credentials mounted read-only at /run/oats-credentials/<name>, each once: names only. Absent: [].

packageVersion.description: Exactly two forms: a bare version (v2.1.3) resolved through the catalog, or git:<repo>@<ref> (a direct package ref). lib/packages.mjs#classifyPackageValue is the full grammar.

memberRef.description: A repo ref (git:<host>/<path>, https://…, git@host:path.git, ssh://<user>@<host>[:<port>]/<path> with no password, file:///…) with NO @revision.

repoKey.description: Canonical repo identity <host>/<path> (or local/<abs-path> for file remotes), as produced by parseRepoRef(...).key.

fromLocation.description: WHERE a capability comes from — a location, never a version.

slotDefault.description: At most one capability fills a slot; `none` leaves it empty.

team.description: The messaging provider's team id (for oats.aweb, <team>:<namespace>). Absent: declared, not yet created. The kernel's safety rule: never '-'-led, no whitespace or control characters, at most 256 characters; the provider validates its own shape.

default.description: The soul's default team: a label of teams: in this file.

teams.description: The other teams the soul may join: labels of teams: in this file, or "any" for every one that is no sandbox's team. [] (or no teams) is default only.

soul.description: Repository-relative directory holding the soul's soul.yaml.
